items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: INTERVIEWER: And that's Warnick? That's Warnick, yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] And this? That's Joe Newman, he's playing with bass in our bass.

ctx.x: No, they went over there for a while, you know. But they're right here from the city.
So, Warnick didn't play clarinet at the time?

No, he was playing saxophone alto. Only. But he played clarinet. He taught him in other ways. T.O. taught him. Mm-hmm. And who's the sousaphone player? This fellow here. He's in New York now. He's a British subject. A.C. Gary is his name. A.C. Gary? Yeah, this is Johnny Lindsey. He played the trombone.
